file_id: Sri Pradip Basak & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 8 September, 2025

sentences.text:
Sri Pradip Basak & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 8
September, 2025
 28.
08.09.2025
Bd.
Crr 2162 of 2025 Sri Pradip Basak & Anr.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Indranuj Dutta
 Ms. Benazir Sk. ... for the petitioners.
Petitioner no. 1 is the father-in-law and petitioner no. 2 is the mother-in-law of the

-complainant who initiated Nimta Police Station Case No. 97 of 2024 under sections
498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code corresponding to Gr Case 2661 of 2024

.  It is submitted that upon completion of investigation police has submitted charge-sheet under section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code on 9th September, 2024 and learned court below has also taken cognizance upon the said offences.
It is further submitted that the allegations leveled against the present petitioners are omnibus in nature.
No specific role has been attributed against the present petitioners.

Even during investigation the witnesses have also not attributed any specific allegation against the present petitioners and as such the present proceeding should be nipped in the bud qua the present petitioners.
In support of his contention he relied upon the judgment of Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam & Ors. -vs- State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 1 SCR 558.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam & Ors. -vs- State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 1 SCR 558
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and also going through the materials available on record, the application is admitted.
Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of application upon the opposite parties intimating next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
Let the matter be listed on 17th November, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
State is directed to produce the case diary on the date fixed.

Having heard learned counsel for the petitioners, it appears that the petitioners have made out an arguable case, which requires adjudication, and as such the impugned proceeding being GR No. 2661 of 2024 presently pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Court Barracpore, North 24 Parganas, is stayed qua the present two petitioners till end of November, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, 1st Court Barracpore, North 24 Parganas
